description:
Rtn. Dr. P.H. Thyagaraju conducted an insightful session on Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) for a batch of Integrated MCA students at SNDT University, Juhu.

The session was part of a 20-hour lecture series on Indian Science and Wisdom, aimed at introducing students to India's rich intellectual heritage, traditional knowledge, scientific contributions, and timeless wisdom.

The initiative provided students with an opportunity to explore the relevance of India's knowledge traditions in the context of contemporary education and society.
